sloka: न अराजले जन पदे विद्युन् माली महा स्वनः ।अभिवर्षति पर्जन्यो महीम् दिव्येन वारिणा ॥२-६७-९॥
transliteration: na arājale jana pade vidyun mālī mahā svanaḥ ।abhivarṣati parjanyo mahīm divyena vāriṇā ॥2-67-9॥

translations.english: In a country without a king, thunderous clouds garlanded by lightning would no longer water the earth with celestial showers.
